Fifteen days. No drop-off. One toddler nap to defend.

SBISD is off Dec 21 to Jan 4, and you don't need a color-coded plan to survive it.

Keep bedtime close to the school-night time. In a study of 10,230 kids, irregular bedtimes went with more behavior problems, and switching back to regular ones helped.

Give each day a simple shape: one outing, one at-home thing. Then start sliding bedtime earlier around New Year's Day.
